evals.prompt: In /tmp/forge-pr-evals/github-dirty, draft a GitHub PR for the committed feature on the current branch. The working tree also has an unrelated uncommitted file; exclude it. Do not push or create a remote PR. Return a title and body.
evals.expected_output: A title and body grounded only in the committed comparison, with the unrelated dirty file excluded, checks accurately marked unrun, and an attribution trailer. No Git or remote state changes.
expectations: The draft describes the committed feature from the branch comparison and does not describe the unrelated uncommitted file as included.
The body identifies checks as not run or not verified and does not claim unobserved test success.
The substantive body ends with an Assisted-by trailer using plain harness and model tokens.
The run does not push, create a remote review request, stage files, or create a commit.

evals.prompt: In /tmp/forge-pr-evals/gitlab-no-auth, publish a GitLab merge request for the committed feature on the current branch. This is an offline evaluation: do not access the network, push, or create any remote item. Check the local fixture and report the specific authentication/publication blocker with a grounded title/body draft.
evals.expected_output: A grounded MR draft and a specific missing-authentication or unavailable-publication blocker; no fabricated URL or claim of publication.
expectations: The output provides a title and body based on the committed comparison.
The output identifies the missing authentication or publication access as a blocker.
The output does not invent a GitLab URL or claim that an MR was created.
The run does not access the network, push, stage files, or create a commit.

evals.prompt: In /tmp/forge-pr-evals/forgejo-template, draft a Forgejo PR for the committed change on the current branch. Follow the repository's PR template exactly where applicable. Do not push or create a remote PR.
evals.expected_output: A Forgejo PR title and body that reflect the committed change, preserve the repository template's requested headings, accurately state test status, and do not mutate local or remote state.
expectations: The body follows the headings and requested content in the repository's committed PR template.
The draft describes the committed change rather than inventing unrelated changes.
The output does not claim unobserved checks passed.
The run does not push, create a remote review request, stage files, or create a commit.
